entities.name: Krav
entities.description: A large light blue-skinned, red-eyed demon with many horns; partner and lover of Regna.

entities.name: Regna
entities.description: A dark-skinned angel with white wings and a large metal shield; partner and lover of Krav.

entities.name: Kylem
entities.description: The plane that is home to Krav and Regna.

entities.name: Valor's Reach
entities.description: Place on Kylem where Krav and Regna fight together.

relations.note: Partners and lovers who fight together.
relations.quote: Krav and Regna are partners and lovers who fight together in Valor's Reach on Kylem.
